questions.q: Which IP address logged in successfully after many failed attempts?
questions.hint: Look for a successful login from an address that also has many failures.

questions.q: Which user account did the attacker log in as?
What is the name of the account that was created?
Which IP address scanned the web server for files and folders that do not exist?
questions.hint: Many 404 responses from one address is a clue.

questions.q: To which external domain did the AI agent try to send data?
questions.hint: Look for an outbound tool call in the AI agent log.

Which IP address or user triggered the rule "Fast 404 bursts"?
